title.zh: JFrog Artifactory CVE-2026-82329：修補釋出僅 4 天即遭實際利用，攻擊者免認證偽造管理者 token
title.en: JFrog Artifactory CVE-2026-82329: exploited just four days after the fix, with attackers minting admin tokens without credentials

content.zh: JFrog 於 8 月 28 日公布 Artifactory 的 CVE-2026-82329（CVSS 9.8，CWE-287 不當驗證）並隨 7.161.20 版釋出修補。漏洞位於負責核發與驗證憑證的 JFrog Access 元件：在預設組態下且未額外設定 join key 的自管（self-managed）安裝，會接受一組「幽靈」join key，攻擊者可據此偽造存取權並產生管理者層級的 token——換言之，只要網路可達，未持有效憑證者即可取得管理權限。安全研究團隊 watchTowr 於 9 月 1 日、也就是公告與修補公開後第 4 天，即觀察到實際利用行為，攻擊者確實在為自己核發管理者 token；CISA 於 9 月 2 日將其列入 KEV。這則的嚴重性不只在 CVSS：Artifactory 是集中式的軟體製品庫，位於建置管線的信任邊界上，取得其管理權等同於具備竄改建置產出、在製品中植入內容、並沿供應鏈向下游傳播的能力，同時往往可取得存放於其中的部署憑證。上期本站已報導另一個 Artifactory 路徑穿越漏洞入 KEV，兩則合起來的訊號很明確：製品庫正在被當作供應鏈攻擊的主要目標，而不是附帶目標。
content.en: JFrog published CVE-2026-82329 (CVSS 9.8, CWE-287 improper authentication) in Artifactory on 28 August and shipped the fix in version 7.161.20. The flaw is in JFrog Access, the component responsible for issuing and validating credentials: under default configuration, a self-managed installation with no additional join key configured can receive a "phantom" join key, which an attacker can abuse to forge access and generate administrator-level tokens — meaning anyone with network reachability and no valid credentials can obtain administrative privileges. Security research firm watchTowr observed real-world exploitation on 1 September, four days after the advisory and fix went public, with attackers minting themselves admin tokens; CISA added it to KEV on 2 September. The severity is not only the CVSS score. Artifactory is a centralised artifact repository sitting on the trust boundary of the build pipeline, so administrative control of it means the ability to tamper with build outputs, plant content in artifacts, and propagate downstream through the supply chain — and typically also access to deployment credentials stored inside it. Last issue we reported a separate Artifactory path traversal entering KEV; taken together the signal is clear: artifact repositories are now a primary supply chain target, not a collateral one.

action.zh: (1) 自管 Artifactory 立即升級至 7.161.20 或更新版本，並確認 join key 已明確設定而非留空；(2) **修補不等於安全**：檢視 8 月 28 日以來的管理者 token 核發紀錄、新增或提權的帳號、以及非預期的製品上傳與權限變更，這是本則最關鍵的動作；(3) 若發現異常，須將所有存放於 Artifactory 的憑證（部署金鑰、雲端存取金鑰、簽章金鑰）視為外洩並輪換，並回溯檢查受影響期間產出的製品完整性；(4) 結構性補強：把製品庫的管理介面移出可公開觸及的網段，對製品簽章與驗證建立強制流程（build provenance），使單一元件淪陷不足以污染下游；(5) 對 CRA 適用範圍內的製造商，請確認自家 SBOM 與建置管線的完整性證據能支撐 Article 13 的漏洞處理義務。
action.en: First, upgrade self-managed Artifactory to 7.161.20 or later immediately, and confirm a join key is explicitly configured rather than left empty. Second, **patching is not the same as being safe**: review administrator token issuance since 28 August, accounts added or escalated, and unexpected artifact uploads or permission changes — this is the most important action here. Third, if you find anomalies, treat every credential stored in Artifactory (deployment keys, cloud access keys, signing keys) as exposed and rotate them, then check back over the integrity of artifacts produced during the affected window. Fourth, structurally: move the repository's management interface off any publicly reachable segment, and put mandatory artifact signing and verification (build provenance) in place so that compromise of one component is not enough to poison everything downstream. Fifth, for manufacturers in CRA scope, confirm that your SBOM and build pipeline integrity evidence can actually support the Article 13 vulnerability handling obligations.

title.zh: Chrome V8 零日 CVE-2026-85046 遭實際利用，Google 緊急修補：今年第 6 個
title.en: Chrome V8 zero-day CVE-2026-85046 exploited, emergency fix shipped: the sixth of the year

content.zh: Google 於 9 月 3 日至 4 日釋出 Chrome 緊急更新，修補 V8 JavaScript／WebAssembly 引擎中的型別混淆（type confusion，CWE-843）漏洞 CVE-2026-85046，並確認該漏洞已遭實際利用。技術上，問題出在編譯器把一個 PACKED_ELEMENTS 陣列錯配為 PACKED_SMI_ELEMENTS 的 map，可被轉化為對 JavaScript heap 的任意讀寫；利用結果是使用者造訪特製網頁後，攻擊者可在 Chrome 沙箱內執行任意程式碼。受影響版本為 152.0.7977.82 之前的 Chrome，修補版本為 Windows／macOS 的 152.0.7977.82／.83 與 Linux 的 152.0.7977.82。Google 依慣例在更新推送完成前未公開威脅行為者、目標對象與攻擊活動細節。CISA 已於 9 月 4 日將其列入 KEV。這是 Google 今年修補的第 6 個遭實際利用的 Chrome 零日；瀏覽器零日的實務含意在於它幾乎不需要使用者的額外操作，一次瀏覽即可觸發，且沙箱逃逸常與此類漏洞搭配使用，因此不應以「僅限沙箱內」為由降低處理優先序。
content.en: Google shipped an emergency Chrome update on 3–4 September for CVE-2026-85046, a type confusion flaw (CWE-843) in the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine, and confirmed it is being exploited in the wild. Technically, the compilers give an array containing PACKED_ELEMENTS the map PACKED_SMI_ELEMENTS, which can be turned into arbitrary read and write on the JavaScript heap; the practical result is that after a victim visits a crafted page an attacker can execute arbitrary code inside Chrome's sandbox. Chrome versions before 152.0.7977.82 are affected, with fixes in 152.0.7977.82/.83 for Windows and macOS and 152.0.7977.82 for Linux. As usual, Google withheld details of the threat actors, targets and campaigns while the update was still rolling out. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on 4 September. This is the sixth actively exploited Chrome zero-day Google has fixed this year. The practical significance of a browser zero-day is that it needs almost no additional user action — a single visit is enough — and sandbox escapes are routinely paired with flaws like this, so "it's only inside the sandbox" is not a reason to lower the priority.

action.zh: (1) 透過端點管理或群組原則強制推送 Chrome 更新至 152.0.7977.82 以上，並**驗證實際生效版本**而非僅下發政策——瀏覽器更新常因使用者長期未重啟而未真正套用；(2) 同步處理 Chromium 衍生瀏覽器（Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 等）與嵌入 Chromium 的桌面應用（Electron 應用），這些常被漏掉，且更新節奏落後於 Chrome；(3) 對高風險族群（研發、財會、高階主管、可存取 OT 網段的工程工作站）優先確認完成率，並考慮暫時啟用強化站台隔離或限制不必要的瀏覽；(4) 把「瀏覽器版本合規率」納入常態指標——今年 6 個零日的節奏說明這不是偶發事件，而是需要以流程而非個案處理的常態風險。
action.en: First, force the Chrome update to 152.0.7977.82 or later through endpoint management or group policy, and **verify the version actually in effect** rather than just pushing the policy — browser updates frequently fail to apply because users never restart. Second, handle Chromium-derived browsers (Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi) and desktop applications that embed Chromium (Electron apps) at the same time; these get missed routinely and their update cadence lags Chrome's. Third, confirm completion rates first for high-risk populations — R&D, finance, executives, and engineering workstations with access to OT segments — and consider temporarily enabling stricter site isolation or limiting unnecessary browsing. Fourth, add browser version compliance rate to your standing metrics: six zero-days this year is not an anomaly, it is a recurring risk that needs a process rather than case-by-case handling.

title.zh: CNIL 對法國一家私立醫院開罰 50 萬歐元：病歷系統無 VPN、無多因素驗證，一組帳號外洩 52 萬名病患資料
title.en: France's CNIL fines a private hospital EUR 500,000: no VPN, no MFA on the patient record system, and one account exposed 524,867 patients

content.zh: 法國資料保護主管機關 CNIL 於 9 月 3 日對 HÔPITAL PRIVÉ DE LA LOIRE 處以 50 萬歐元罰鍰，理由是未採取適當措施確保病患及其指定聯絡人的資料安全。事件經過：2025 年夏季，攻擊者成功登入該院集中儲存所有就診者資料的電子病歷系統（DPI），存取了 524,867 名病患的資料（部分含健康資料）與 202,246 名被指定為「信賴第三方」者的資料。CNIL 認定的缺失具體到近乎教科書：資料外洩當日，該院對電子病歷系統的存取**既不需要 VPN、也不需要多因素驗證**，攻擊者正是直接利用這個缺口，僅憑一組被入侵的帳號即進入系統；且攻擊者在系統內翻查病歷期間未被偵測。除罰鍰外，CNIL 並命令該院限期改善資安工具，且軟體供應商 Expert Santé 對病歷系統的存取須經醫院事前授權，逾期未改善將處以按日計罰。這則對本站讀者的價值不在醫療業本身，而在裁罰理由的形態：主管機關的認定重點是「缺少基本控制」，不是「未能抵禦先進攻擊」。
content.en: France's data protection authority CNIL fined HÔPITAL PRIVÉ DE LA LOIRE EUR 500,000 on 3 September for failing to take appropriate measures to secure the data of its patients and certain of their named contacts. What happened: in the summer of 2025 an attacker successfully logged into the hospital's electronic patient record system (DPI), which centralises data on everyone treated there, and accessed the records of 524,867 patients (health data among them for some) plus 202,246 people designated as trusted third parties. CNIL's findings are almost textbook-specific: on the day of the breach, access to the patient record system required **neither VPN nor multi-factor authentication**, and the attacker exploited exactly that gap, entering with a single compromised account; the attacker then went through patient records without being detected. Alongside the fine, CNIL ordered the hospital to bring its security tooling into compliance and to grant its software vendor Expert Santé access to the record system only on prior authorisation, on pain of daily penalty payments. The value of this item for our readers is not the healthcare setting but the shape of the reasoning: the authority's finding rests on missing basic controls, not on failure to repel an advanced attack.

action.zh: (1) 把這則當成一份現成的稽核題目：列出貴組織所有可從外部存取、且集中儲存個資或營業秘密的系統（ERP、PLM、HR、客戶資料庫、檔案伺服器），逐一確認是否強制多因素驗證，沒有的請列為本季必辦；(2) 特別檢查**供應商／軟體商的遠端存取路徑**——本案 CNIL 特別針對此下令，而這條路徑在多數組織中既長期存在又缺乏逐次授權機制；(3) 檢視「攻擊者在系統內未被偵測」這一點：對集中式資料庫建立異常查詢量的偵測規則（單一帳號短時間內大量讀取紀錄），這是資料外洩最可靠的早期訊號之一；(4) 在管理層簡報時使用本案作為對照——罰鍰理由可直接對應 ISO 27001 附錄 A 的存取控制與鑑別控制項，比抽象的合規論述更有說服力。
action.en: First, use this as a ready-made audit exercise: list every system in your organisation that is externally accessible and centrally stores personal data or trade secrets (ERP, PLM, HR, customer databases, file servers), check each for enforced multi-factor authentication, and make anything without it a must-do this quarter. Second, look specifically at **remote access paths used by vendors and software suppliers** — CNIL issued a specific order on exactly this, and in most organisations that path both exists long-term and lacks any per-session authorisation. Third, take seriously the finding that the attacker went undetected inside the system: build detection rules for anomalous query volume against centralised databases (one account reading large numbers of records in a short window), which is one of the most reliable early signals of exfiltration. Fourth, use this case in management briefings — the grounds for the fine map directly onto the access control and authentication controls in ISO 27001 Annex A, which is far more persuasive than an abstract compliance argument.
